da-physical-implausibility.evidence: file:50: The double beta decay is a fiber descent: the interaction products ... cascade through two Skein smoothings
da-physical-implausibility.notes: Interpreting double beta decay as a sequence of purely topological Skein smoothings from a genus-2 surface down to a genus-1 surface via a Higgs-like figure-eight knot is highly speculative. It completely ignores the established electroweak mechanism of beta decay.
